title: Fascism as a movement
summary: On 23 March 1919 Benito Mussolini founded the Fasci italiani di combattimento at a meeting of about fifty interventionists, former socialists, syndicalists, arditi and futurists in Milan's Piazza San Sepolcro. Its squads attacked unions, socialist cooperatives and opposition papers. In 1921 the movement became the National Fascist Party, and after the March on Rome in 1922 Mussolini ruled Italy as dictator until 1943. His was the first fully fledged fascist regime, a model for other movements across interwar Europe.

uncertainty.note: Founded 23 March 1919 at Piazza San Sepolcro in Milan; European fascist regimes collapsed at the close of World War II in 1945.
